description: Free, no payment. Lists every Genesis402 endpoint with its name, HTTP path, USD price, title and parameter schema, read from the live /.well-known/x402 manifest. Call this first to find the right endpoint name and parameters for genesis402_call; the dedicated genesis402_* tools cover the most used endpoints directly. Read-only. Returns the total count, the matches and the current payer mode.

filter.description: Optional keyword to narrow the list, matched against endpoint name, title and tags, e.g. "defi", "sec", "price". Omit for all endpoints.

name: genesis402_catalog

name.description: Endpoint name to pass to genesis402_call.

price_usd.description: Price per call in USD, null if the manifest carries none.

matched.description: Number of endpoints matching the filter.

origin.description: Rail origin the catalog was read from.

payer_mode.description: QUOTE_ONLY, HOSTED, or LIVE (cap $X) for a local self-paying server.

total_endpoints.description: Number of endpoints in the live manifest.

title: List endpoints and prices (free)
